decisions.reason: Measuring all 3.3V-rail current does not change the specified power sources, diode OR-ing method, or source-selection behavior.
The monitoring coverage does not change the standalone USB power source, activation condition, capacity, or powered load scope.
The source decision concerns current measurement on the 3.3V rail and does not alter the addressable LEDs' 5V supply, switching, or logic-level handling.
Current-monitor coverage does not change any panel control, connector, GPIO, reset, touch-input, or capacitance requirement.
The decision does not change the main-board connector count, connector destinations, USB-C inventory, or pin-count characteristics.
Monitoring all rail current does not modify the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The source decision applies to monitoring the 3.3V rail and does not change the separate switched 5V boost supply or its loads.
The current-monitor coverage does not affect I2C series-resistor values, placement, purpose, or population policy.
No GPIO assignment or pin-compatibility decision is entailed by requiring the INA219 to monitor all 3.3V-rail current.
The decision does not alter battery-charge indication, its LED chain, connector, GPIO, or resistor configuration.
Although the interboard connector carries 3.3V, the source does not change its signals, pin-order policy, connector types, or matching-numbering requirement.
Main-board 3.3V current-monitor coverage does not change the battery connector's pin functions, placement, orientation, family, or mounting style.
